replacements.text: The routing table in the delegation skill is meant to be the only inventory of model ids. Nothing enforced that. A new test suite reads the Markdown files under `src/` except those under an `evals` or `node_modules` directory. It fails `make ci` on a model id the table does not list. Anthropic aliases such as `sonnet` are not caught.
The lint rejects a word that is not a model id. That rejection blocks every pull request.
The patterns are case-sensitive. All 94 files in the real tree lint clean.
Delete the test file. Nothing ships from it.
An unlisted id appended to a skill made `make content-tests` exit 2. The command named the line.

A pytest suite beside the delegation skill fails on an unlisted model id. It also fails on a table row outside the routing table that names any model id. It fails on a routing table that changes shape.
Each vendor naming scheme has one case-sensitive pattern. A family name in prose therefore does not count as an id.
The lint allows two tables in the routing file. The file's Providers table therefore becomes a list.
The delegation-coherence spec defines ids by vendor naming scheme. An alias does not follow such a scheme.
An unlisted model id in any Markdown file the lint reads under `src/` causes a failure. The failure names the file and the id.
A fenced example with a listed id fails once the id's row is removed from the routing table.
An absent or empty routing table causes a failure. The failure names the routing table.
A table row outside the routing table that names a listed id fails. The same id in prose passes.

A pytest suite beside the delegation skill reads every Markdown file under src/ except those under an evals or node_modules directory. It fails on unlisted model ids, table rows elsewhere naming model ids, or routing tables with changed shapes. The lint allows two tables in the routing file. The file's Providers table therefore becomes a list.

make ci exits 0 at the head. All 20 content suites pass. All 34 cases fail against a stub lint. Every case passes at the head. One unlisted id appended to a skill made the gate exit 2. The gate named the line. Anthropic aliases are not caught. No review round ran.
